title: Cooking for a Large Gathering
paragraphs: When Layla agreed to host her extended family for Eid, she underestimated exactly how much cooking would be involved for over twenty guests arriving throughout the entire afternoon.
Two days before the gathering, she made a detailed list and asked her sister and cousin to help prepare some dishes in advance, rather than trying to cook everything herself on the actual day.
On the morning of Eid, the kitchen was busy but organized, with each person responsible for a specific dish, which meant nobody felt overwhelmed despite the large number of guests expected.

By the time everyone arrived, the meal was ready without any last-minute panic. Layla realized that asking for help early, rather than insisting on doing everything alone, made the whole day far more enjoyable.
